item.title: Researcher Claims 6TB China LLM Router Logs Exposed Enterprise Credentials
item.description: Security researcher Chaofan Shou said he obtained about 6TB of invocation logs from a Chinese large-model relay and found SSH keys, cloud credentials and tokens tied to enterprises. The report is presented as a supply-chain risk claim pending confirmation.
